title: Dispatch FLE 5: The Living Explorer Meets Her Other Daughter
summary: A private meeting changes the question before the inquiry.
topic: A Funeral for a Living Eidetician
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: Lydia Voss met Dr. Voss at the Institute. They compared a scar on the explorer’s wrist, letters, and memories of childhood. Lydia said her mother lost that scar after the expedition; the living Dr. Voss still bears it. Neither took the difference as proof of deceit.

Lydia asked whether the burial could retain her mother’s name. Dr. Voss agreed, provided the records distinguish their two lives. The magistrate has not yet ruled on how a single civil name can be entered twice.
